show.description: Pratik, a gifted designer and secret husband of billionaire CEO Krishika Dhawan, joins Vista as an intern to earn success on his own merit. But Adi, a manipulative imposter, pretends to be Krishika’s husband and humiliates him at every step. Amid office politics, betrayal, family conflict, and deadly conspiracies, Pratik fights to protect his marriage, prove his identity, and emerge as the true visionary behind KP-Vista’s success Watch now.
